name: Tropical Oasis
notes: DoorDash JSON-LD Menu block for '417 Telegraph Canyon Road, Chula Vista' matches this restaurant's batch address exactly. Raw item count was 91; a 'Most Ordered' carousel section (12 items) was dropped because every one of its name+price pairs duplicated an item already present in another section (standard DoorDash carousel duplication), leaving 79 unique dishes - which triggered the '79-item truncation' flag, so cross-checked against order.online's own RSC menu-category book for the same store. 8 of 9 DoorDash category names and item counts matched order.online's corresponding categories exactly (Juices/Diet & Energy 11, Wellness Shots 8, Smoothies/Agua Frescas 2, Favorites 21, Bowls 9, Torta & Sandwich 18, Combos 4), confirming the 79-item set is complete rather than truncated; only Breakfast differs (6 on DoorDash vs 12 on order.online), so a handful of breakfast items may exist on order.online that are not on DoorDash - not filed here since DoorDash was used as the base source. order.online's book also contains ~100 additional items under a second, differently-named/duplicate category set (e.g. 'Diet Energy Juices', 'Natural Juices', 'Frutas') that overlap with the primary set rather than representing new items, and were not used. All prices are USD.
